_comment: marble_portal: Map 2's way out of the ring, a drop-in for the hell-rock portal.glb that scenes/ring/portal.tscn instances. The same 4.5 x 4.0 x 0.8 m footprint and the same mouth to the centimetre -- 2.7 m clear at the ground, the head springing at 2.6 and crowning at 3.15, the effect surface centred on 1.5 -- so the scene's Gate Area3D (a 4.0 x 3.6 x 1.0 box at local y 1.8) and its Glow omni at y 2.0 are untouched. What changes is the stone: instead of rock torn open round an ember, the rotunda's own architecture at prop scale -- an ashlar plinth, two fluted pilaster jambs, an arched head, a cornice moulding, every reveal and wash and soffit in the 'shade' cell. The head is the circular arc through the three fixed numbers, radius 1.9318, which is the rotunda's own 2.0 m head stilted by 6.8 cm rather than a different arch; six chords, mb.HEAD_SEG. Plinth and cornice stand at half depth 0.40, the pilaster fronts and the spandrel 0.10 back at 0.30, so the washes and the soffit are real surfaces. ONE CLOSED MANIFOLD SOLID, 172 tris, 88 verts, one component, no boundary edge: the mouth is not a hole but a plug -- the two effect-surface faces stand at y = -0.02 and +0.02 and each side's reveal runs from its own outer face in to that plane, so every edge carries exactly two faces (V - E + F = 88 - 258 + 172 = 2). The surface itself is Map 1's, unchanged: portal_build._paint_swirl into marble's spare atlas cell (2, 3), drawn with the one marble material -- Principled BSDF, albedo plus emissive, Closest interpolation, emission strength exactly 1.0 -- so one textured material, one UV set, no skin, no animation. MarblePortalCollision is that silhouette extruded flat through the full 0.8 m (56 tris: two uprights and the arched head, the effect surface deliberately absent, because a body walks through it); Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` stays 1 and `max_tris` counts only what is drawn. max_tris 200: 172 measured, 15% headroom.
